theme.title: Full-Court Mix
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: What was Giannis Antetokounmpo's points average in the 2021 playoffs?
questions.context: Milwaukee · entire postseason, not only the Finals
questions.note: 30.2 a game, capped by 50 points in the title-clinching Game 6.

funFacts.text: He also averaged 12.8 rebounds a game during that postseason.
Giannis started every playoff game he appeared in.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo | 21 | 21 | 38.1

funFacts.text: He was named Finals Most Valuable Player after Milwaukee defeated Phoenix.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo was named NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

questions.prompt: The first All-Star Game, in 1951, drew 10,094 fans. How many people watched the record-setting 2010 game at Cowboys Stadium?
questions.context: 2010 NBA All-Star Game · held in a football stadium
questions.note: 108,713, more than ten times the first All-Star crowd in 1951.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In 2010, the NBA All-Star Game set the attendance record for a basketball game with 108,713 people

funFacts.text: The game was played on February 14 at Cowboys Stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The venue for the game on February 14 was Cowboys Stadium

funFacts.text: All-Star Saturday Night events were held on February 12 and 13.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: NBA All-Star Saturday Night events were held on February 12 and February 13, 2010

funFacts.text: It was the first All-Star Game in which neither team wore white.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This marked the first All-Star game where neither team wore a white uniform

questions.prompt: Reggie Miller retired in 2005 as the career leader in threes. How many had he made?
questions.note: 2,560. He had passed Dale Ellis for the career lead back in 1997.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: eventually retiring with a record 2,560 three-pointers made.

funFacts.text: Miller overtook Dale Ellis for the career lead in 1997, well before the modern three-point explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In 1997, Miller surpassed Ellis as the NBA's all-time leader in three-pointers

funFacts.text: During Miller's career, the NBA briefly shortened the three-point line for three seasons before restoring it.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: For three seasons beginning in 1994–95, the NBA attempted to address decreased scoring by shortening the distance

funFacts.text: The NBA's later three-point revolution is often credited to Stephen Curry and his unusually deep attempts.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stephen Curry, who is credited with revolutionizing the game by inspiring teams to more heavily employ the three-point shot

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other big Finals rebounding games. In the game that clinched the 1972 title, Wilt had 24 points and how many boards?
questions.context: 1972 NBA Finals · Game 5 · vs New York
questions.note: 29 rebounds at age 35, with a sprained wrist, plus the Finals MVP award.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilt Chamberlain scored 24 points and 29 rebounds and earned the NBA Finals MVP Award

funFacts.text: Chamberlain was listed as doubtful for the clincher with a sprained right wrist, yet played anyway.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain was listed as doubtful for Game Five with a sprained right wrist

funFacts.text: ABC announcer Keith Jackson informally tallied Wilt's blocks before the NBA officially tracked them.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: ABC announcer Keith Jackson counted them up during the broadcast

funFacts.text: The victory delivered the Lakers' first championship since the franchise relocated from Minneapolis.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: win their sixth NBA title and their first since 1954, when the team was still based in Minneapolis

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry's 13 threes in 2016 set the single-game record. How many did he make in the 2022 All-Star Game in Cleveland?
questions.note: 16 threes in one All-Star Game, on his way to 50 points and MVP.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: set the record for most three-pointers made in an All-Star quarter (6), half (8), and game (16)

funFacts.text: He scored 50 points in the Cleveland exhibition.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Team LeBron's Stephen Curry, who scored 50 points

funFacts.text: Curry took home the Kobe Bryant All-Star MVP trophy.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: was also named the All-Star Game Kobe Bryant Most Valuable Player

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
